name: Background fill
description: Removes text or residual smears by replacing selected text-like pixels with an estimated or explicitly chosen background color.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Controls how replacement pixels are chosen. Auto estimates a locally monotonic background from pixels surrounding the selection; manual uses the explicit background color.

options.name: Auto
options.description: Estimates the background color from clean neighboring pixels and fills only pixels classified as foreground text or smear.

options.name: Manual
options.description: Uses the selected background color without automatic color estimation.

fields.name: selected_region
fields.description: Defines the image-space rectangle to analyze and clean. The rectangle limits classification and fill; it does not mean every pixel inside the rectangle will be overwritten.

fields.name: background_color
fields.description: Shows or overrides the RGB color used to replace classified text pixels. In Auto mode it displays the locally estimated background; in Manual mode it is the user-selected fill color.

action.name: Fill selected region
action.description: Classifies text-like pixels inside the selected rectangle and replaces only those pixels with the configured background color, producing a reversible edit.
